== Summary ==
Brian Fred with the World Championship trophy, 25 October 2026, at the [[2026 World Championship]] (Hyatt Regency Bloomington by Mall of America, Bloomington, Minnesota).

== Source ==
Photo posted by imrahil327 in the Players Committee Slack, #announcements, 25 October 2026: "Congrats to our newest World Champion, @retwin316!" (file IMG_0201). Provided by Bill Bisco.
